description: Returns the most recent raw APRS packets (TNC2 text as received from APRS-IS) sent by one callsign, newest first, with the time each was received (UTC). Packet text is written by the station and returned unmodified apart from control characters and a 512-character cap per packet. The backend keeps raw packets for about 24 hours. Stations that ask not to be archived (APRS "!x!" marker) return no packets, and any single packet carrying the marker is left out.

callsign.description: Station callsign with optional SSID, for example TA4OHN-10. Case-insensitive.

limit.description: Maximum number of packets to return (1–50, default 20).

name: get_station_raw_packets
title: Get station raw packets
